# clumio_aws_environment (Data Source)

clumio_aws_environment data source is used to retrieve the identifier of the Clumio AWS environment associated with an AWS account and region for use in other resources or actions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example retrieving the Clumio AWS environment of an AWS account and region
data "clumio_aws_environment" "example_aws_environment" {
  account_native_id = "AWS Account ID"
  aws_region        = "AWS Region"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_native_id` (String) Identifier of the AWS account associated with the environment.
- `aws_region` (String) The AWS region associated with the environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the AWS environment.
